of the United States Code, as amended, and äs President o f the United

reasons: The located ACT quote ends before the acting instrument's numbered provisions. Read and cite the applicable operative provision; a heading or introductory amendment formula does not supply the later sections.

current_reported_gaps: First end not established: EO 11540 replaced this order's item text effective 1970-07-01, when the Bureau of the Budget was redesignated the Office of Management and Budget, and EO 11708 revoked EO 11248 as amended on 1973-03-23 while placing an OMB Assistant Director in level IV under its own section 1. Whether the 1970 substitution ended this placement (a different, generic OMB office) or only retitled the same position, so that the clause ended in 1973, is a legal judgment no held source settles; first_end and whole_order_end are left open, with both events recorded as later events.

reported_material_gaps: First end not established: EO 11540 replaced this order's item text effective 1970-07-01, when the Bureau of the Budget was redesignated the Office of Management and Budget, and EO 11708 revoked EO 11248 as amended on 1973-03-23 while placing an OMB Assistant Director in level IV under its own section 1. Whether the 1970 substitution ended this placement (a different, generic OMB office) or only retitled the same position, so that the clause ended in 1973, is a legal judgment no held source settles; first_end and whole_order_end are left open, with both events recorded as later events.
versions.research_rationale: EO 11367 of August 18, 1967 (official text 32 FR 12037, saved OCR text layer read in full; the order fills PDF page 7) adds '(5) Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President' to section 1 (level IV) of EO 11248. The 1989 OFR disposition table records it as superseded by EO 11708 of March 23, 1973 (38 FR 7979, read in full), whose section 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended except for eight level V positions. The saved-text corpus shows an earlier event: EO 11540 of July 1, 1970 (35 FR 10735, read in full) substitutes 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' for this order's words, effective July 1, 1970. The clause is terminated by 1973 at the latest, but which event first ended it is not asserted (see gap). Partial claim.

savings_residuals.reason: Neither EO 11540 nor EO 11708 has a savings clause for this placement, and the order created no position, fund or vested right: it only placed an office in level IV. EO 11708 section 1(9) places 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' in level IV under its own authority, which is EO 11708's provision, not a residue of this order.

later_events.note: replaces 'Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget' in item (5) with 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget', effective July 1, 1970 (the day the Bureau of the Budget became the Office of Management and Budget).

Sec. 3. Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2

later_events.note: revokes EO 11248, as amended, except for the eight level V positions continued by its section 2; EO 11708 states no effective date, so it took effect on signing, March 23, 1973.

savings_residuals.reason: Neither EO 11540 nor EO 11708 has a savings clause for this placement, and the order created no position, fund or vested right: it only placed an office in level IV. EO 11708 section 1(9) places 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' in level IV under its own authority, which is EO 11708's provision, not a residue of this order.

unresolved_material_gaps: First end not established: EO 11540 replaced this order's item text effective 1970-07-01, when the Bureau of the Budget was redesignated the Office of Management and Budget, and EO 11708 revoked EO 11248 as amended on 1973-03-23 while placing an OMB Assistant Director in level IV under its own section 1. Whether the 1970 substitution ended this placement (a different, generic OMB office) or only retitled the same position, so that the clause ended in 1973, is a legal judgment no held source settles; first_end and whole_order_end are left open, with both events recorded as later events.
claim.research_rationale: EO 11367 of August 18, 1967 (official text 32 FR 12037, saved OCR text layer read in full; the order fills PDF page 7) adds '(5) Assistant Director for Executive Management, Bureau of the Budget, Executive Office of the President' to section 1 (level IV) of EO 11248. The 1989 OFR disposition table records it as superseded by EO 11708 of March 23, 1973 (38 FR 7979, read in full), whose section 3 revokes EO 11248 as amended except for eight level V positions. The saved-text corpus shows an earlier event: EO 11540 of July 1, 1970 (35 FR 10735, read in full) substitutes 'Assistant Director, Office of Management and Budget' for this order's words, effective July 1, 1970. The clause is terminated by 1973 at the latest, but which event first ended it is not asserted (see gap). Partial claim.
